name: Gemini CLI
author: Enplace
summary: Send work to the Gemini CLI on your own computer, on your own plan.
description: Send copies a prompt for the work item. Paste it into the Gemini CLI on your computer: with Enplace added as an MCP server (Settings → Agents → Other agents shows the command), it picks the item up, reports progress and hands it back for review. Messages you leave on the item reach it on its next Enplace call.

runner.hint: Copies a prompt for the Gemini CLI on your computer, which picks it up over MCP.
runner.prompt:
Work on Enplace work item {key}: {title}

Use the enplace MCP server's tools: call start_work with key {key} first and follow what it returns, post progress with add_note, and finish with submit_for_review (a short report and any pull request link).
